headerDisplay: Exposes Eufy RoboVac robots as **native Matter Robotic Vacuum Cleaner** devices through Homebridge 2's Matter support. Requires Homebridge 2.0+ with Matter enabled on this (child) bridge, and a Matter controller (Apple Home needs iOS 18.4+).
footerDisplay: You need each robot's **deviceId** and **localKey**. See the README for how to obtain them with the eufy-clean-local-key-grabber. Control is local (Tuya LAN); the robot must be on the same network as Homebridge.

name.title: Platform Name
name.description: Name shown for this platform in the Homebridge logs.

name.title: Name
name.description: Name for this robot (shown in your Matter/Home app).

deviceIp.title: Device IP (optional)
deviceIp.description: Static IP of the robot. Optional, but setting it improves performance and reliability.

protocolVersion.title: Tuya protocol version
protocolVersion.description: Tuya LAN protocol version. If the robot connects but every command times out, try 3.4, then 3.5.
